title: The site agent is told to change only what was asked, asks before writing anything shared, and is told about a change nobody asked for
steps: S1: build the site context for each CMS and mode.
S2: run consequenceOf on model writes to a WordPress template part, a Joomla module, an EmDash site entry.
S3: send a WordPress whole-body write changing two blocks.
S4: a visual-check judge stand-in answers shown with also.
expect: S1: every session's context carries the SCOPE line; all:true only when asked.
S2: each asks first, nothing sent.
S4: exactly one notice telling the agent to put back just that.

selectors.code: site-context.mjs SCOPE, consequence.mjs shared, site-call.mjs BODY_WIDE, visual-check.mjs also

evidence: Staff report 20/10/2026: 'when Tracy fixes one place it often breaks another'; no scope rule, shared records written without asking, visual check had no verdict for unasked changes
fence: Scope rule in context, ask-first on shared records, whole-body guard, visual-check also

tests: an update of a record other pages show asks first: WordPress part, template, synced pattern, menu
a Joomla module update asks first, naming that it shows on every page it is assigned to; a new one does not
EmDash: an update of the site entry asks first; any other collection's entry does not
a whole body that changes two blocks is refused BODY_WIDE, nothing written, and sent to blocks with the rev
🔒 a judge naming an unasked change steers ONE notice; cannot_tell or shown without it steers none
